integrity: Analytic derivation and reproducible numerical/symbolic comparisons in verify.py; not an independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: Long-time isotropic diffusivity for an independently driven two-state Markov swimmer, with opposite state-dependent angular velocities, motility only in one state, Ω>D_R and r≥1. The limiting λ↓0 value is a limiting stationary mixture. The cited 2012 asymmetric-angle-drive paper was available only as abstract and metadata; historical priority requires further full-text comparison. Finite computations complement, not replace, the analytic proof.
title: A sharp finite-switching diffusion resonance in an intermittently motile chiral swimmer
